definitions.explanation: Water, especially bath water, that is only slightly warm.
A safe, easy situation that asks little of a person and so breeds complacency. Usually critical.

examples.japanese: ぬるま{湯|ゆ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{顔|かお}を{洗|あら}う→顔を洗う：23572_kaowoarau⟧。
examples.english: I wash my face with lukewarm water.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ぬるま{湯|ゆ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{風呂|ふろ}→お風呂：00802_ofuro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Babies are bathed in lukewarm water.

examples.japanese: ⟦セーター→セーター：01371_seetaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ぬるま{湯|ゆ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{優|やさ}しく→優しい：02640_yasashii⟧⟦{手洗|てあら}い→手洗い：12761_tearai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please wash the sweater gently by hand in lukewarm water.

examples.japanese: ぬるま{湯|ゆ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{慣|な}れて→慣れる：00870_nareru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I've grown used to taking it easy.

examples.japanese: ぬるま{湯|ゆ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{職場|しょくば}→職場：04164_shokuba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成長|せいちょう}→成長：03290_seichou⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: You can't grow in a workplace that is too comfortable.

examples.japanese: ⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ぬるま{湯|ゆ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|つ}かっていた→浸かる：13290_tsukaru⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{不況|ふきょう}→不況：04844_fukyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苦|くる}しく→苦しい：02636_kurushii⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The company, which had been sitting comfortably with no competition, was suddenly in trouble when the recession hit.

notes:
From ぬるい (lukewarm) + ⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧ (hot water). The figurative sense pictures someone who stays in a tepid bath because getting out would be cold.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ぬるま{湯|ゆ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|つ}かる→浸かる：13290_tsukaru⟧: to be steeped in complacency
- ぬるま{湯|ゆ}⟦{体質|たいしつ}→体質：08243_taishitsu⟧: a complacent culture (of a company or organization)
- ぬるま{湯|ゆ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧: an undemanding environment

USAGE:
In sense 2 the word is almost always critical: it implies that the comfort is making someone lazy or unprepared.
